PROPERTY FINDERS ONLY

Separate from Atlas Goods Store and The Floopies.

This inactive dry-run workflow uses synthetic records only. No scraping, API calls, Smartsheet writes, seller contact, buyer referrals or finance decisions occur.

Before production: verify lawful data sources, UK coverage, stable dedupe key, Smartsheet columns, credentials, audit trail, retries and human approval gates.
